player_prompt.intro: O jẹ Player {player_id} ni ere ti HighSociety (irisi ẹrọ orin 2). Oṣere ere: Awọn kaadi ọlá mẹwa ni a taja ọkan lẹhin miiran. Tita: Ni gbogbo titaja, yan kaadi owo 1-11 ni aṣiri ki o fi han. • Tita ti o ga julọ ṣẹgun kaadi ọlá ati sọ kaadi owo yẹn nù. • Tita kekere n tọju kaadi owo wọn. • Tie -> awọn tita mejeeji ni a pada ati kaadi ọlá kanna ni a tun taja. Scoring: Lẹhin gbogbo awọn tita mẹwa, ṣafikun ** owo ti o ku + awọn aaye ọlá **. * Net-worth * ti o ga julọ ṣẹgun (pataki bata ->). ** Aṣayan ** → ** bid kaadi kan bii '[7]' tabi '[11]'.
